entities.summary: The Most Rev. Brendan Oliver Comiskey was a Catholic clergyman who served as Bishop of Ferns from 1982 to 2002. Comiskey resigned on 1 April 2002, over charges that he had failed to deal adequately with allegations that Seán Fortune and others were sexually abusing children.
